arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Left matrix or vector. A Matrix is filled down columns from a flat sequence.

arguments.name: y
arguments.text: Right matrix or vector, filled the same way.

origin.details: A vector on the left is treated as a row when its length equals the number of rows on the right. A vector on the right is treated as a column when its length equals the number of columns on the left. Two vectors of the same length return a 1 by 1 matrix holding the inner product. The numeric cells are the product, independent of storage order.
